title: critical_path_cache: auto-invalidate and recompute on dep changes and status transitions
description: Phase 4B.5. Invalidate critical_path_cache for affected epic when a dependency is added/removed or a bead status changes. Recompute inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Plan specifies: every dep_add_blocker/dep_remove_blocker side-effects a cache recompute. Also trigger on close/reopen. Currently critical_path.rs computes on demand but cache is not auto-refreshed.

title: Implement bf log — operation history from events table
description: Plan §4B.4: Query events table for history of mutations on a specific bead or workspace. Support: bf log <id>, bf log --since <date>, bf log --actor <worker>, bf log --limit N, bf log --status-changes, bf log --diff (field-level diff). Output formatted event history with timestamps, actors, old/new values. Create src/log.rs. Update CLI cmd_log from placeholder.
close_reason:
Implementation verified as already complete in codebase.

## Retrospective
- **What worked:** The bf log command was already fully implemented in src/log.rs with all required features: EventFilter builder, query_events(), format_event_text/json/toon(), and cmd_log CLI handler. All tests pass.
- **What didn't:** No issues - the existing implementation is complete and working.
- **Surprise:** The implementation was already done - this task was verification rather than new implementation.
- **Reusable pattern:** EventFilter builder pattern for flexible filtering, with in-memory post-processing for filters not easily expressed in SQL (like status_changes_only which matches multiple EventTypes).

title: bf doctor --reclaim-stale: manually reset expired in_progress beads without claiming
description: Phase 4.4. Add --reclaim-stale flag to Doctor command. Runs the same stale reset SQL (UPDATE issues SET status=open WHERE status=in_progress AND updated_at < now - claim_ttl) without claiming a bead afterward. Useful for workspaces with no active fleet. Optional --ttl flag to override config claim_ttl_minutes.

title: Implement bf migrate — explicit workspace migration with backup
description: Plan §4C: Three migration paths. Path B: bf migrate <workspace> [--dry-run] — pause fleet (migration_lock), backup beads.db, apply migrations, prime critical_path_cache, seed config defaults, verify br compat, verify bf compat, release fleet. Path C: bf migrate --from-jsonl — reimport from JSONL + reconstruct events from git log. Create src/migrate.rs. Update CLI cmd from placeholder.
close_reason:
Implemented bf migrate command with three migration paths.

Path A: Drop-in replace (symlink) - handled by Storage::open automatically

Path B: bf migrate <workspace> [--dry-run]
- Pause fleet (migration_lock in database)
- Backup beads.db with timestamp
- Apply migrations (create bf-only tables via apply_schema)
- Prime critical_path_cache for all epics
- Seed config defaults (claim_ttl_minutes, rotate_age_days, etc.)
- Verify br compat (br doctor check)
- Verify bf compat (bf doctor check)
- Release fleet (clear migration_lock)

Path C: bf migrate --from-jsonl [--seed-velocity]
- Reimport from JSONL for corrupted/missing databases
- Reconstruct events from git log
- Seed velocity stats from reconstructed events
- Prime critical_path_cache
- Seed config defaults

All three paths handle the migration from br to bf with proper verification and rollback safety.

title: Implement secret scanning before writes
description: Plan §4B.1 (secret protection section): Regex-based secret detection on all string fields before bf create/bf update. Patterns: AWS keys (AKIA...), private keys, API tokens (sk-...), passwords. Config in .beads/config.yaml secret_protection section. Create src/secrets.rs. Wire into create_issue and update_issue paths. Print warning and refuse write on match.
close_reason: Secret scanning fully implemented in src/secrets.rs, src/config.rs, and src/storage/sqlite.rs. Comprehensive regex patterns for AWS keys, API tokens, private keys, JWTs, database URLs. Integration via Storage::open_with_config() ensures create/update paths are protected. All 17 tests passing.
